original: muṇḍamālayā kṛto hāro 'neneti tathoktam | tāṇḍavaṃ raudranṛttam | bhayānakaṃ yathā bhavati tathā kṛṣṇavarṇam | sphārayed iti sphārayantam | vigrahaḥ śarīram | ratīramo viramānandaḥ | saiva dvandvaṃ savikalpatvāt | tatsamāpannaṃ tasya pūrvaṃ saṃmukhīkaraṇāt | anena tattvena kiṃ mudryam ity āha | nairātmyeti | (282v/568) nairātmyayā saha saṃpuṭam |
analyzed: muṇḍa mālayā kṛtaḥ hāraḥ nena iti tathā uktam tāṇḍavam raudra nṛttam bhayānakam yathā bhavati tathā kṛṣṇa varṇam sphārayet iti sphārayantam vigrahaḥ śarīram ratīramaḥ virama ānandaḥ sā eva dvandvam sa vikalpa tvāt tat samāpannam tasya pūrvam saṃmukhīkaraṇāt anena tattvena kim mudryam iti āha nairātmya iti nairātmyayā saha saṃpuṭam

original: nistaraṅgaṃ niṣprapañcaṃ sukhaṃ sahajānandaḥ | tadavāptaṃ prāptavantam | anena tattvena kiṃ mudryam ity āha | nistaraṅgasvarūpiṇam | sarvaprapañcapratipakṣatvān nistaraṅgaṃ yat svarūpaṃ hevajrarūpam tad asyāstīti tathoktam | vikarālinaṃ vikaṭadaṃṣṭram | caturviṃśatinetrāḍhyaṃ mukhāṣṭakam | pratyekaṃ raktavartulatrinetratvāt |
analyzed: nistaraṅgam niṣprapañcam sukham sahaja ānandaḥ tat avāptam prāptavantam anena tattvena kim mudryam iti āha nistaraṅga svarūpiṇam sarva prapañca pratipakṣa tvāt nistaraṅgam yat svarūpam hevajra rūpam tat asya asti iti tathā uktam vikarālinam vikaṭa daṃṣṭram caturviṃśati netra āḍhyam mukha aṣṭakam pratyekam rakta vartula tri netra tvāt

original: asyā gāthāyā anantaraṃ śṛṅgārādir ekā gāthā boddhavyā | (283r/569) sarvamukheṣu śṛṅgāro rasaḥ | śvete śāntaḥ | aśvete raudraḥ | śeṣeṣu yathāyogam | caṣakaṃ kapālaṃ madanapūritam | kapālaṃ raktapūritam |
analyzed: asyāḥ gāthāyāḥ anantaram śṛṅgāra ādiḥ ekā gāthā boddhavyā sarva mukheṣu śṛṅgāraḥ rasaḥ śvete śāntaḥ a śvete raudraḥ śeṣeṣu yathāyogam caṣakam kapālam madana pūritam kapālam rakta pūritam

original: evaṃ vividhavidhānam iti | bhagavanniṣpattividhiṃ kṛtvotsṛṣṭagauryādīr nyaset | gauryā vāmayor dhanuḥ | sarohitamatsyaraktabhūtakapālaṃ ca | cauryā vāmayor aṅkuśaṃ sasūkaraṃ raktakapālaṃ ca | pramohā ḍombī tasyā vāmayoḥ pañcāmṛtakapālastha(283v/570)jambukaḥ | pṛthivyuddharaṇaṃ ca lāṅgalam | vettālī sitavalitapītā |
analyzed: evam vividha vidhānam iti bhagavat niṣpatti vidhim kṛtvā utsṛṣṭa gaurī ādīḥ nyaset gauryāḥ vāmayoḥ dhanuḥ sa rohita matsya rakta bhūta kapālam ca cauryāḥ vāmayoḥ aṅkuśam sa sūkaram rakta kapālam ca pramohā ḍombī tasyāḥ vāmayoḥ pañcāmṛtakapāla stha jambukaḥ pṛthivī uddharaṇam ca lāṅgalam vettālī sita valita pītā

original: vāmayoḥ karoṭabhūte madyamūtre savye saraktakapāle kūrmaḥ | pukkasyāḥ savyayor māṃsapūrṇakapālasthasiṃho varadamudrā ca | caṇḍālyāḥ savye raktabhūtakapāle vyāghraḥ | ghasmarī hariteṣatpītā | vāmayor vajrāṅkitāgnikuṇḍaṃ parśuś ca | savyayor medaḥpūrṇakapālasthasarpo 'bhayamudrā ca | śabaryāḥ savyayoḥ saśukra(284r/571)kapālasthabhikṣur vajraṃ ca |
analyzed: vāmayoḥ karoṭa bhūte madya mūtre savye sa rakta kapāle kūrmaḥ pukkasyāḥ savyayoḥ māṃsa pūrṇa kapāla stha siṃhaḥ varada mudrā ca caṇḍālyāḥ savye rakta bhūta kapāle vyāghraḥ ghasmarī harita īṣat pītā vāmayoḥ vajra aṅkitā agnikuṇḍam parśuḥ ca savyayoḥ medaḥ pūrṇa kapāla stha sarpaḥ bhaya mudrā ca śabaryāḥ savyayoḥ sa śukra kapāla stha bhikṣuḥ vajram ca

original: upasaṃharati bhāvayed viśvarūpiṇīr iti | vidhivad iti | karoṭeṣv anuktadravyasya rohitādeś ca vidhānam | alaṃkāraś cakryādiḥ | āsāṃ ca bījānukramato nyāsaḥ | tatra gaurīcaurīvettālīghasmarīpukkasīśabarīcaṇḍālīpramohā yathākramaṃ saumyaraudraharṣamṛtacarvaṇābhinayanṛtyaśāntordhvamukhamadanapramohadṛṣṭimukhyaḥ (?) |
analyzed: upasaṃharati bhāvayet viśva rūpiṇīḥ iti vidhivat iti karoṭeṣu anukta dravyasya rohita ādeḥ ca vidhānam alaṃkāraḥ cakrī ādiḥ āsām ca bīja anukramataḥ nyāsaḥ tatra gaurī caurī vettālī ghasmarī pukkasī śabarī caṇḍālī pramohāḥ yathākramam saumya raudra harṣa mṛta carvaṇa abhinaya nṛtya śānta ūrdhvamukha madana pramoha dṛṣṭi mukhyaḥ

original: prācyavācīpratīcyudīcyeśā(284v/572)nyāgneyīnairṛtīvāyavīṣu digvidikṣu yathākramaṃ bhāvyāḥ | hayarūpādīnāṃ pradhānasavyetarordhvakramato vaktravarṇam āha | kṛṣṇetyādi | siṃhavaktraṃ raktaṃ pratyālīḍhaṃ padaṃ dvārapālānām eva | anyadevatās tv ardhaparyaṅkiṇyaḥ | vaṃśādīnāṃ yathākramaṃ hūṁ hūṁ hūṁ hūṁ hrīḥ trāṁ hāṁ trāṁ iti bījāni |
analyzed: prācī avācī pratīcī udīcya īśā āgneyī nairṛtī vāyavīṣu diś vidikṣu yathākramam bhāvyāḥ haya rūpa ādīnām vaktra varṇam āha kṛṣṇa ityādi siṃha vaktram raktam pratyālīḍham padam dvārapālānām eva anya devatāḥ tu ardha paryaṅkiṇyaḥ vaṃśa ādīnām yathākramam hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hrīḥ trāṁ hāṁ trāṁ iti bījāni

original: atra ca indriyādhiṣṭhānaṃ kāyavākcittādhiṣṭhānam abhiṣeko mudraṇaṃ (285r/573) pūjādikaṃ ca jñātavyam iti ||
analyzed: atra ca indriya adhiṣṭhānam kāya vāc citta adhiṣṭhānam abhiṣekaḥ mudraṇam pūjā ādikam ca jñātavyam iti

original: abhisamayas tv asya bhagavato yathā prāguktaherukatrayasya viśeṣas tu kūṭāgārodare vidhivad ālikālijacandrasūryamadhyahūṁāḥjātakaroṭakartristhabījadvayam iti sarvapariṇataṃ vajrasattvaṃ ṣaḍmudriṇam aṣṭāsyādiviśiṣṭaṃ vibhāvya manthyamanthānajabodhicittabindūdbhavagaṁcaṁvaṁghaṁpuṁśaṁcaṁpraṁbījajāḥ padmodarān niḥsṛtya gauryā(285v/574)dayo
analyzed: abhisamayaḥ tu asya bhagavataḥ yathā prāc ukta heruka trayasya viśeṣaḥ tu kūṭāgāra udare vidhivat iti sarva pariṇatam vajra sattvam ṣaṣ mudriṇam aṣṭa āsya ādi viśiṣṭam vibhāvya manthya manthāna ja bodhi citta bindu udbhava gaṁ caṁ vaṁ ghaṁ puṁ śaṁ caṁ praṁ bīja jāḥ padma udarāt niḥsṛtya gauryā 285 iti

original: yathāsthānaṃ draṣṭavyāḥ | tato hoḥkāradvayavidarbhitarūpaṃ cittaṃ mukhena padmāntaḥ praviśet | tato mahārāgāt savidyayā dravībhūtau vajrī uṭṭhetyādinā saṃcodito devīpraveśānantaraṃ taddravajahūṁityādipariṇataḥ oṁ dharmadhātusvabhāvātmako 'ham iti paṭhet |
analyzed: yathāsthānam draṣṭavyāḥ tatas hoḥkāra dvaya vidarbhita rūpam cittam mukhena padma antar praviśet tatas mahārāgāt savidyayā dravībhūtau vajrī uṭṭha ityādinā saṃcoditaḥ devī praveśa anantaram tad drava ja hūṁ ityādi pariṇataḥ om dharmadhātu svabhāva ātmakaḥ ham iti paṭhet

original: tataś cakṣuradhiṣṭhānādyādiyogānantaraṃ nairātmyāyāḥ śirasi oṁkāraṃ sitam aparāparasūkṣmauṁkārair hṛtparyantaṃ vyāptaṃ hṛdi (286r/575) hūṁkāraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ tathaiva kaṭiparyantaṃ guhye āḥkāraṃ raktaṃ tathaiva pādatalaparyantaṃ vibhāvyam | oṁ padma sukhādhāra mahārāgasukhaṃdada caturānandabhāg viśva hūṁ 2 kāryaṃ kuruṣva me |
analyzed: tatas cakṣuḥ adhiṣṭhāna ādi ādi yoga anantaram nairātmyāyāḥ śirasi oṁkāram sitam apara apara sūkṣma oṁkāraiḥ hṛd paryantam vyāptam hṛdi hūṃkāram kṛṣṇam tathā eva kaṭi paryantam guhye āḥkāram raktam tathā eva pāda tala paryantam vibhāvyam om padma sukha ādhāra mahārāga sukhaṃdada caturānanda bhāj viśva hūṃ kāryam kuruṣva me

original: oṁ vajra mahādveṣa caturānandadāyaka khagamukhaikaraso nātha hūṁ 2 kāryaṃ kuruṣva me iti padmaṃ vajraṃ cādhiṣṭhāya ratim ārabhya pūrvavad gauryādidevīr utsṛjet | devī bhagavāṃś ca svabījanirjātotav (?) utsṛjyātmany anta(286v/576)r bhāvayet | tataś cakṣurādyadhiṣṭhānaṃ pūrvavat sarvāsāṃ kuryāt |
analyzed: om vajra mahādveṣa caturānanda dāyaka khagamukha ekarasaḥ nātha   kāryam kuruṣva me iti padmam vajram ca adhiṣṭhāya ratim ārabhya pūrvavat gaurī ādi devīḥ utsṛjet devī bhagavān ca utsṛjya ātmani anta bhāvayet tatas cakṣuḥ ādi adhiṣṭhānam pūrvavat sarvāsām kuryāt

original: tato jñānasattvapraveśo 'bhiṣeko mudraṇam amṛtāsvāda iti maṇḍalarājāgryādikaṃ bhāvayej japed iti ||
analyzed: tatas jñāna sattva praveśaḥ bhiṣekaḥ mudraṇam amṛta āsvādaḥ iti maṇḍala rājāgrya ādikam bhāvayet japet iti
